title: Fake Medicare Calls Demanding Payment
how_it_works: Scammers call pretending to be from Medicare, saying your benefits will be cut off unless you pay a fee or give personal information. They may sound very official and try to scare you.
example_message: "This is Medicare. Your coverage will be canceled unless you pay a $299 reactivation fee right now. Please provide your credit card number to continue your benefits."
red_flags: Caller asks for payment or personal details over the phone
what_to_do: Hang up and call Medicare directly using the number on your card if you have questions.

title: Text Message Package Delivery Scam
how_it_works: You get a text saying you missed a package delivery and need to click a link to reschedule. The link leads to a fake site that tries to steal your information or install malware.
example_message: "Your package delivery is pending. Please confirm your address by clicking here: [fake link]"
red_flags: Link to a website you don’t recognize
Requests for personal or payment info
what_to_do: Do not click the link; delete the message and contact the delivery company directly if you’re expecting a package.

title: Social Security Email Phishing
how_it_works: Scammers send emails pretending to be from Social Security, saying there’s a problem with your account. They ask you to click a link or download an attachment to fix it, which can steal your information.
example_message: "We have detected suspicious activity on your Social Security account. Please verify your information immediately by clicking this link."
red_flags: Email says there’s a problem with your account
Asks you to click a link or download something
what_to_do: Do not click any links or download attachments; go to the official Social Security website or call them directly.

title: Facebook 'Friend in Trouble' Scam
how_it_works: A scammer hacks a friend’s Facebook account and sends you a message saying they’re in trouble and need money. They may ask for gift cards or wire transfers.
example_message: "Hi, I’m stuck out of town and lost my wallet. Can you send me a $200 gift card? I’ll pay you back as soon as I get home."
red_flags: Urgent request for money from a friend
Asks for payment by gift card or wire transfer
Message seems out of character for your friend
what_to_do: Call your friend directly to check if the message is real before sending any money.

title: Grandparent Emergency Scam
how_it_works: You get a call from someone pretending to be your grandchild, saying they’re in trouble and need money fast. They may beg you not to tell anyone else.
example_message: "Grandma, it’s me! I’m in jail and need $1,000 for bail. Please don’t tell Mom and Dad. Can you send the money right away?"
red_flags: Caller claims to be a grandchild in urgent trouble
Wants money sent quickly, often by wire transfer or gift card
what_to_do: Hang up and call your grandchild or another family member to check if the story is true.
